description: Realisiere mit Fastned die Mobilität von morgen! Wir wollen unser Expansionsteam für die Region Süd rund um München verstärken.  Die Mobilität verändert sich grundlegend. Elektrofahrzeuge werden zum Alltag, neue Technologien entwickeln sich rasant und der Bedarf an leistungsfähiger Ladeinfrastruktur wächst. Fastned gestaltet als Unternehmen für ultraschnelles Laden diese Entwicklung aktiv mit. Als Pionier im Bereich der Schnellladeinfrastruktur haben wir es uns zum Ziel gesetzt, bis 2030 ein europaweites Netz von über 1.000 Schnellladestationen aufzubauen. Ein Job an der Schnittstelle von Immobilien, innovativer Technologie und Nachhaltigkeit Als Senior Expansion Manager:in entscheidest du mit, wo die nächste Generation unserer Schnellladestationen entsteht. Du identifizierst attraktive Standorte in deiner Region, sprichst Eigentümer:innen, Projektentwickler:innen, Unternehmen und Kommunen an und entwickelst daraus langfristige Partnerschaften. Du arbeitest in einer innovativen und schnell wachsenden Branche, in der sich Markt, Technologie und rechtliche Rahmenbedingungen kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln. title: Agentic Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Who is Sonar? Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable. Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world's leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you're hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.   The Impact You Will Have: As an Agentic Software Engineer on the Platform Architecture squad, you will build the multi-agent systems that autonomously refactor and modernize Sonar's own codebase — starting with one of our biggest technical bets: unifying SonarQube Cloud (SQC) and SonarQube Server (SQS) onto a single, portable architecture ("build once, deploy twice"). You will: Design and build agentic refactoring pipelines that can safely extract a domain's logic from our existing SQS/SQC codebases and re-platform it onto our Unified Core (a hexagonal "capability-core + adapters" architecture), with minimal human oversight. Define the guardrails that make autonomous refactoring safe at scale — verification gates, automated test generation, static analysis, and rollback strategies that let agents move fast without breaking production code relied on by 7M+ developers. Prove the approach on real migrations — Micronaut-to-Spring conversions, Lambda-to-container consolidations, API convergence (consolidating overlapping API surfaces onto shared contracts), and strangler-fig domain extractions — before scaling it into a repeatable, multi-agent "coding squad" capable of tackling many domains in parallel. Stay hands-on in the Java/Spring codebase often enough to critically review what the agents produce, recognize when a refactor is architecturally wrong, and correct the agentic loop that generated it — not just the output. What You Will Do Spend the majority of your time (roughly 70%) designing, building, and iterating on agentic tooling: orchestration, tool-use, context management, and evaluation harnesses for autonomous code-modification agents. Build and refine the verification layer that gates what agents are allowed to ship — automated test generation, regression detection, static analysis (using our own SonarQube), and human-in-the-loop checkpoints where warranted. Spend the remainder of your time (roughly 30%) hands-on in our Java/Spring codebase: reviewing agent-generated pull requests, fixing what they get wrong, and feeding those lessons back into the tooling. Partner closely with the Server, Cloud Platform, and value-stream squads whose domains you're migrating — earning their trust and buy-in matters as much as the code itself. Contribute to the Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and standards that govern how our platform evolves. Track and evaluate emerging agent frameworks and techniques, bringing back what's genuinely useful — as distinct from what's just hype — for accelerating engineering across Sonar. Experience and qualifications Hands-on experience building or operating multi-agent or LLM-agent systems in a real production setting — not just prompting a coding assistant, but designing the orchestration, tool-use, and guardrails around autonomous agents. Experience building evaluation or verification systems for AI-generated changes: automated testing, static analysis, regression detection, or comparable safety nets for code you didn't personally write. Strong software engineering fundamentals in Java and Spring (or a comparable JVM/enterprise stack) — enough to read a large, mature codebase critically and tell good architecture from bad. A track record of owning complex, ambiguous technical problems independently and driving them to resolution — this is an R&D-flavored role inside a production platform team, and you'll be shaping the playbook, not following one. Experience influencing engineers and squads you don't manage — the migrations you'll enable depend on their trust as much as on your code. Additional comments This role is based in Bochum, Germany . We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Bochum , but we are willing to relocate the right candidate. Benefits Pension Scheme: 1st Pillar (Unterstützungskasse): Automatic, financed by Sonar, 3% of gross salary, an additional benefit in addition to your salary. Pension Scheme:2nd Pillar (bAV): Voluntary, 15% contribution by Sonar from social security savings. We encourage usage of our robust time-off allocations with 28 PTO days plus additional days based on seniority and circumstances. Sonar recognizes holidays on working calendar days. If the holiday date occurs on a Saturday, we will recognize the day on the preceding Friday. If the holiday date occurs on a Sunday, we will recognize the day on the following Monday. Public transport reimbursement of 60% for annual subscription. Generous discretionary Company Growth Bonus, paid annually.   Global workforce with employees in 20+ countries representing 35+ unique nationalities. We have an annual kick-off somewhere in the world where we meet to build relationships and goals for the company.         Salary range:  We value diversity, equity, and inclusion At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at .  All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.  Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered. description: Wer wir sind Wir sind Xempus, Deutschlands führende unabhängige Software-as-Service (SaaS)-Plattform für den Vertrieb und die Verwaltung betrieblicher Vorsorgelösungen. Ob von einem unserer Büros oder von zu Hause ­– Komm zu uns und lass uns gemeinsam eine sicherere Zukunft für alle schaffen! Was Dich erwartet Du führst unsere Software Engineers disziplinarisch und fachlich. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit mehreren cross-funktionalen Teams zusammen und unterstützt sie bei ihrer persönlichen und fachlichen Entwicklung. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Engineering-Aktivitäten mit der Unternehmensvision und den strategischen Produktzielen von Xempus im Einklang stehen. Du verantwortest technische Initiativen von der Konzeption bis zum produktiven Betrieb – einschließlich technischer Planung, Architektur, Qualitätssicherung und Weiterentwicklung. Gemeinsam mit Product Ownern priorisierst du technische Themen im Product Backlog und schaffst Transparenz über Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und notwendige Investitionen. Du triffst fundierte technische Entscheidungen, reviewst Lösungsansätze und stellst die Einhaltung von Engineering-Standards, Best Practices und Qualitätsanforderungen sicher. Du arbeitest eng mit Product, Operations, Customer-facing Teams und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen, um technische Möglichkeiten mit geschäftlichen Anforderungen zu verbinden. Du entwickelst unsere Engineering-Prozesse, Wissensmanagement-Formate und Standards kontinuierlich weiter. Du unterstützt die langfristige Weiterentwicklung und Modernisierung unserer Plattform – mit Blick auf Stabilität, Performance, Wartbarkeit und Skalierbarkeit. Du begleitest Projekte und Produkte bis in den produktiven Betrieb und stellst gemeinsam mit den Teams einen zuverlässigen laufenden Betrieb sicher. Du kannst dich schnell in große, komplexe Codebasen einarbeiten, erkennst übergreifende Zusammenhänge und leitest daraus fundierte Architekturentscheidungen ab. Du verfügst über ein sehr gutes Verständnis von Softwarearchitektur, Design Patterns, Clean Code und modernen Engineering-Prinzipien. Du denkst strategisch und kannst langfristige Pläne für die Weiterentwicklung, Modernisierung und schrittweise Verbesserung gewachsener Systeme entwickeln und umsetzen. Du hast Freude daran, bestehende Systeme zu analysieren, zu refaktorieren und nachhaltig zu verbessern – ohne Stabilität und Performance aus dem Blick zu verlieren. Du kennst dich mit Datenbanken, APIs und dem gesamten Softwareentwicklungsprozess aus – von der technischen Konzeption über die Umsetzung bis zum Betrieb. Du hast Erfahrung in der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung sowie im Coaching und in der Weiterentwicklung von Software Engineers. Du kannst technische Projekte strukturieren, priorisieren und gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern erfolgreich umsetzen. Du treibst den Einsatz von KI aktiv voran - von KI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung über automatisierte Qualitätssicherung bis hin zur Optimierung unserer Entwicklungsabläufe. Du kommunizierst sicher mit technischen und nicht-technischen Ansprechpartnern und agierst souverän zwischen Engineering, Product, Management und externen Partnern. Du arbeitest gerne in einem agilen Umfeld, gehst konstruktiv mit Veränderungen um und bringst dich aktiv in die kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Entwicklungsprozesse ein. title: Director Product (m/w/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Unsere Produkte sind der Grund, warum Kund:innen bei uns kaufen und immer wieder zurückkommen. Als Director Product (m/w/d) verantwortest du alles, was dahintersteht, für alle Marken der SNOCKS Group: von der ersten Produktidee über Sourcing und Produktion bis zur Lieferung ins Lager. Product Development, Sourcing und Supply Chain aber auch Quality Management und ESG sind dein Kern, und genau dort bist du strategisch wie operativ tief drin. Du setzt die Richtung, führst die Heads und ihre Teams und hältst die Fäden über alle Abteilungen hinweg zusammen. Wenn es darauf ankommt, sitzt du selbst mit am Tisch der Supplier. Kurz: Du bist die Person, die unser Produkt-Business nach vorne bringt, mit Weitblick und mit beiden Händen im Tagesgeschäft. Deine Aufgaben Produktstrategie : Du entwickelst mit den PD-Heads und in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CEO Rehan die Produkt- und Sortimentsstrategie für unsere Marken, bewertest neue Kategorien und übersetzt alles in eine klare Roadmap. Product Development: Du steuerst die Entwicklung neuer Produkte und Launches, challengst Ideen und sorgst dafür, dass aus guten Konzepten erfolgreiche Produkte werden. Sourcing & Supplier Management : Du verantwortest unsere Supplier-Landschaft, vor allem in China und Pakistan, baust eigene, belastbare Beziehungen auf und verhandelst Preise, Qualität und Timings gemeinsam mit unserem Supply Chain Team. Den Aufbau von Direct Sourcing treibst du strategisch voran. Supply Chain: Du sorgst für eine stabile, effiziente Lieferkette von der Bestellung bis zur Ware im Lager und erkennst Engpässe, bevor sie zum Problem werden. Performance & Zahlen: Du hast die Performance der Brands und neuer Launches im Blick, gehst in Product Deep Dives und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten. Leadership : Du führst die Heads sowie die Teams aus Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality Management und ESG mit Empathie, klaren Zielen und ehrlichem Feedback. Bei dir laufen alle Fäden zusammen und du entwickelst die Menschen weiter. Krisen- & Konfliktmanagement: Wenn es intern oder bei Suppliern brennt, bleibst du ruhig, deeskalierst und findest Lösungen. Prozesse & Workflows: Du baust Strukturen, die wirklich funktionieren, und machst unseren Produktbereich skalierbar. Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du bist Schnittstelle zu fast allen Bereichen der Gruppe, von Brand und E-Commerce über Marketplace bis Finance, und bist Sparringspartner:in für Rehan. Dein Profil Studium : Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Textilmanagement oder ein vergleichbarer Hintergrund. Noch wichtiger ist uns, was du in deiner Laufbahn schon aufgebaut und bewegt hast. Erfahrung : Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Product Development, Sourcing und Supply Chain, idealerweise in der Textilbranche. Die Kategorie ist zweitrangig, Fashion-Erfahrung ist ein Plus. Leadership-Erfahrung : Du hast bereits Teams und Führungskräfte geführt und tust das mit Empathie, Klarheit und echtem Interesse an den Menschen. Product Development : Du bringst fundiertes Know-how in der Produktentwicklung mit, von der Idee über Sampling bis zur Serienreife, und erkennst, was ein Produkt erfolgreich macht. Sourcing & Supply Chain : Du hast Supplier-Landschaften bereits aktiv gesteuert, kennst Produktions- und Lieferprozesse im Detail und kannst Kosten, Qualität und Timings fachlich challengen. QM & Sustainability : Du hast ein solides Grundverständnis für Qualitätsmanagement und Nachhaltigkeit. Strategie & Hands-on : Du denkst strategisch, arbeitest aber genauso gern operativ mit, vor allem in der Supplier-Kommunikation. Ins kalte Wasser zu springen schreckt dich nicht ab. Verhandlungsstärke : Du verhandelst souverän und selbstbewusst, auch dann, wenn es ungemütlich wird. Sourcing-Netzwerk : Ein bestehendes Netzwerk im Direct Sourcing oder Erfahrung im Aufbau davon ist ein dickes Plus. Erfahrung mit Produktion in China und Pakistan ebenso. Mindset : Du sagst klar deine Meinung, übernimmst Ownership wie für dein eigenes Business und gehst mit viel Freiraum verantwortungsvoll um. Reisebereitschaft & Präsenz : Du bist regelmäßig vor Ort in Mannheim und Berlin und reist gern zu unseren Suppliern, bei Bedarf auch spontan. Sprachen : Sehr sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Warum wir? Dich erwartet ein modernes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Du-Kultur von Tag eins. Wir glauben an flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsmethoden. Unsere Teams bestehen aus motivierten Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen. Goodies für dich: Von Jobrad-Leasing über Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket bis hin zu betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (Arbeitgeberzuschuss 50%) - bei uns profitierst du von vielen Extras. On top gibt’s Mitarbeitenden-Rabatt in unserem Snocks Coffee und einen steuerfreien Sachbezug (50€ / Monat), den du flexibel für deinen Wocheneinkauf oder z.B. eine Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club einsetzen kannst. Arbeiten, wie’s zu dir passt : Du arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist. Remote ist Standard, aber wenn du doch mal Lust hast, ins Büro nach Mannheim, Hamburg oder Berlin zu kommen, gibt’s dafür ein Monatsbudget. Echte Flexibilität : Ob Workation mit Freund:innen oder Kolleg:innen, morgendliches Yoga oder eine Sport-Session mittags – bei uns kannst du Arbeit und Privatleben easy miteinander verbinden. Onboarding : Du startest nicht mit leeren Händen, sondern bekommst top Hardware, alles was du zum Arbeiten brauchst, und kannst dir im Welcome Shop coole Produkte von unseren Partnern & Friends aussuchen. Du weißt nicht weiter? Wir unterstützen dich mit unseren Weiterbildungsangeboten und individuellen Development Budgets! Und wenns nicht ums Berufliche geht, kannst du deinen Zugang zur Gesundheitsplattform nilo.health nutzen, um dir den Support zu holen, den du brauchst. Einfach (dir) mal was Gutes tun : Ob „Social Day“, um dich sozial zu engagieren, oder „Power Days“, wenn die Periode mal richtig zuschlägt – diese Tage gibt es on top zu deinem Urlaub. Alle zusammen: Wir sind ein Team aus A-Playern, die nach Wachstum streben, und leben den Team-Spirit bei unseren grandiosen SNOCKS Group Events oder einfach beim nächsten After-Work. Office-Leben: Bei uns wird’s nie langweilig: ob Tischtennis, Fifa oder Mario Kart nach der Arbeit, gemeinsames Kochen und Lunch, frisches Obst, Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine oder die Müsli-Bar. Und das Beste: Dein Haustier darf natürlich auch mit ins Office! Wir kleiden dich ein: Noch keine Produkte der SNOCKS Group in deinem Kleiderschrank? Das ändern wir! Du erhältst jedes Jahr einen 360€ Gutschein von uns sowie weitere tolle Rabatte und Angebote wie bspw. Corporate Benefits. #LI-Remote Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Oversee our assembly & refurbishment activities: Manage our assembly and refurbishment partners, own the bills of material for everything we build from purchased components as well as internal refurbishment within our locations. Experience leading a team of at least 3 direct reports in a supply chain or operations-heavy function. Commercial and financial fluency: Working capital optimization, inter-company transactions or product costing, are all familiar territory for you. Cross-functional communication: You can carry a topic across teams and drive it to a decision. Ownership and a firm, professional attitude: You take the whole problem, not your part of it. English at C1 level or above Nice to have: Hands-on experience with Odoo or a comparable ERP, ideally including experience in shaping or designing a system for supply chain topics rather than execution alone. Background in bike, scooter, mobility or another hardware-heavy industry where physical goods move between internal as well as external locations. German or Dutch What you can expect from us Exciting industry: You will work in the dynamic world of mobility, which is a constantly evolving sector. Shape the future: As part of our growing start-up, you will help to shape tomorrow's mobility. International team & Strong network: Work alongside motivated colleagues from all over the world. title: Werkstudent im Bereich Legal / Compliance (d/m/w)
description: Ihre Aufgaben Bei NYALA begleitest Du die Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots von juristischer Seite. Du lernst, regulatorische Anforderungen umzusetzen sowie zu diesen mit den Aufsichtsbehörden zu kommunizieren. Dabei wendest Du den bestehenden Rechtsrahmen aus eWpG, eWpRV, KWG und GwG an, entwickelst unsere Produkte in diesem weiter, begleitest mit uns aktuelle Entwicklungen bei der Gesetzgebung und nimmst über Stellungnahmen und Konsultationen aktiv Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung der Gesetzgebung zur Blockchain-Technologie. Du hast damit nicht nur die Möglichkeit, die geltenden Regelungen auf konkrete Sachverhalte im Unternehmen anzuwenden (und das anders als in der Kanzlei umfassend und gestaltend, nicht nur im Rahmen eines beschränkten Beratungsauftrags), sondern auch zukünftige Entwicklungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Im operativen Tagesgeschäft arbeitest du direkt dem Geldwäsche-, Compliance- und Risikobeauftragten zu, bereitest Sachverhalte entscheidungsreif auf und hältst Fristen, Maßnahmen und Wiedervorlagen nach. Im Schwerpunkt des Berichtswesens erstellst du Vorlagen für die Berichte an Funktionsträger im Unternehmen, pflegst Kennzahlen und Auswertungen, hältst Richtlinien, Handbücher und Arbeitsanweisungen aktuell und unterstützt bei Jahresabschluss- und Sonderprüfungen. Ihr Profil Du brennst für Technologie und speziell DLT, glaubst an die revolutionäre Chance der Blockchain im Finanzsystem und hast Interesse an kapitalmarktrechtlichen Fragestellungen. Vollständige Vorkenntnisse in eWpG, GwG und KWG erwarten wir nicht; ein großer Teil dieses Rechtsrahmens ist selbst erst wenige Jahre alt und entwickelt sich beständig weiter. Wir erwarten Sorgfalt im Detail, Verbindlichkeit bei Fristen, die Fähigkeit, komplizierte Sachverhalte knapp und nachvollziehbar zu verschriftlichen, und Diskretion im Umgang mit Kunden- und Unternehmensdaten. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch ist für Aufsichtskorrespondenz und im Meldewesen erforderlich, Englisch für Korrespondenz mit internationalen Kunden und für die Interpretation von Rechtstexten von Vorteil. Warum wir? Compliance ist bei uns nicht nur nachgelagerte Kontrollinstanz, sondern Voraussetzung des Geschäftsmodells: ohne belastbare Registerführung und rechtssichere Verfahrensabläufe gibt es kein Kryptowertpapier. Du arbeitest deshalb nicht an einem Ausschnitt, sondern siehst den vollständigen Zyklus – von der Anbahnung eines Emittenten über die Aufnahme in das Register bis zur Berichterstattung an Geschäftsführung und Aufsicht. Die Smart Registry als Institut bietet hervorragende Voraussetzungen, über den Tellerrand zu schauen: Viele unserer Produkte werden durch neue Gesetze erst ermöglicht und erst in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden entwickelt. Wir waren im Februar 2024 der erste Kryptowertpapierregisterführer, welche elektronische Aktien nach dem eWpG eingetragen hat. Werde Teil eines motivierten, technikbegeisterten und internationalen Teams mit starker Unternehmenskultur direkt am Ku'damm in Berlin. Wir bieten dir Einarbeitung unmittelbar durch die Beauftragten, direkten Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – und die Perspektive, in Themen eigenverantwortlich hineinzuwachsen. Wer eine große, arbeitsteilige Compliance-Abteilung sucht, ist bei uns falsch; wer früh Verantwortung und einen ungewöhnlich vollständigen Blick auf ein reguliertes Geschäft will, richtig. raw.title: Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Ab

sofort


Das erwartet dich

Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management.

Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert.

Das erwartet dich

Plattform entwickeln und gestalten

  • Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle)
  • Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung
  • Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle
  • Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept
  • Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt
Automatisieren und standardisieren
  • GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Erstauslieferung bis zum Day-2-Betrieb vollständig automatisiert
  • Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Tools; Policy as Code für Sicherheit und Governance
  • CI/CD-Integration und Standardisierung der Deployment-Prozesse
Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams und Kunden
  • Platform Engineering für interne Teams: Aufbau von Self-Service-Fähigkeiten, Definition von Standards, Begleitung des Onboardings
  • Aktive Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei der Migration ihrer Workloads in die Cloud-Plattform
  • Verarbeitung von Erkenntnissen aus dem laufenden Betrieb (Monitoring-Daten, Incidents) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Stabilität, Sicherheit und Performance


Das bringst du mit

Must-have

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud- oder Platform-Engineering, in Container-Technologien oder Infrastrukturautomatisierung
  • Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen
  • Erfahrung mit GitOps-Workflows (idealerweise ArgoCD oder Fleet) und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Ansible, Terraform)
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Termine an unseren weiteren Standorten
Nice-to-have
  • Erfahrung mit SUSE Stack oder vergleichbaren Kubernetes-Management-Plattformen
  • Kenntnisse in DevSecOps, Policy as Code oder Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepten
  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Stacks (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana)
Persönlich
  • Systemisches Denken statt Ticket-Fokus, mit Blick fürs Gesamtbild
  • Sicheres Auftreten und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe mit Entwicklungsteams wie mit Kunden
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Erfahrung darin, Themen über Team- und Kundengrenzen hinweg zu steuern


Was wir dir bieten

  • Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze deinen Gestaltungsspielraum, um eigene Ideen zu verwirklichen.
  • Arbeite dort, wo Wirkung entsteht: im Office oder direkt beim Kunden. Homeoffice ist die Ausnahme – dafür bieten wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein Office, in dem man gerne arbeitet und den Tag gemeinsam verbringt.
  • Profitiere von internen und externen Schulungen, die dich fachlich und persönlich weiterbringen.
  • Genieße Benefits wie BusinessBike, EGYM Wellpass, Corporate Benefits und einen Zuschuss für den ÖPNV.
  • Neben einem VWL-Zuschuss bieten wir dir eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und eine Kita-Förderung.
  • Ob Surfen, Wandern, Mountainbiken oder Golfen – bei unseren vielseitigen Mitarbeiter-Events ist für jeden etwas dabei!

raw.description:

sofort


Das erwartet dich

Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management.

Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert.

Das erwartet dich

Plattform entwickeln und gestalten

  • Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle)
  • Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung
  • Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle
  • Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept
  • Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt
Automatisieren und standardisieren
  • GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Erstauslieferung bis zum Day-2-Betrieb vollständig automatisiert
  • Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Tools; Policy as Code für Sicherheit und Governance
  • CI/CD-Integration und Standardisierung der Deployment-Prozesse
Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams und Kunden
  • Platform Engineering für interne Teams: Aufbau von Self-Service-Fähigkeiten, Definition von Standards, Begleitung des Onboardings
  • Aktive Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei der Migration ihrer Workloads in die Cloud-Plattform
  • Verarbeitung von Erkenntnissen aus dem laufenden Betrieb (Monitoring-Daten, Incidents) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Stabilität, Sicherheit und Performance


Das bringst du mit

Must-have

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud- oder Platform-Engineering, in Container-Technologien oder Infrastrukturautomatisierung
  • Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Stacks (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana)

title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform
description: Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and powers data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 800 of the world's leading enterprises, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io . About this role: At Astronomer, we’re redefining how companies run Apache Airflow at scale. Our R&D organization is home to some of the most innovative minds in cloud infrastructure and open-source software. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. You get to go in at the ground level of how our production infrastructure is designed, built, tested and deployed. Your work will directly influence how we build Astro, Observe and our IDE product, as well as how global organizations orchestrate data pipelines at scale—making them faster, more reliable, and easier to manage. If you’re driven by impact, excited by scale, and ready to work on the kind of infrastructure challenges that push the boundaries of what’s possible in cloud-native systems, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. What you get to do: Make high-quality, data-driven and experience-driven decisions on how we build this and the next generation of our production platform, then deliver the results. Own and build how we test, build and deploy code in a high-scale PaaS environment. Collaborate across the whole company on how we design production systems, set standards and make technology choices for new and existing products, and how these fit together. Deliver results - we routinely “change the wheels on the bus while it’s moving”, in a predictable, safe and reliable way. Be at the forefront of how we work together as a Platform Engineering team. Blaze a Trail : Work on a small but growing team on building out the Platform/Reliability practice for the company – this role reports directly to the VP of Reliability. Be an Owner : Be directly involved in decision-making on what we work on, as well as how we work on it. Make promises, and keep them. Do Sensible Things : Be directly involved in determining how our platform works. Participate in incident management and determine sensible practices as the platform evolves. Garage Door Open : Create and maintain comprehensive internal documentation for systems and processes, ensuring clarity and accessibility. What you bring to the role: Strong experience in Non-Abstract Systems design and implementation. Strong proficiency in Python, Golang and in-depth experience with Kubernetes (CKA or equivalent or greater). Experience with observability principles and technologies, including SLI/SLO definition and tracking. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in working with a globally distributed team in delivery. A passion for reliability and operational excellence. A low tolerance for toil and other nonsense. Ability to estimate the scope of work accurately and coordinate with stakeholders to address risks and ensure successful project delivery. Experience with (and ideally strong opinions on) software development best practices, such as code review, testing, CI/CD, version control, automation and debugging. Proactive approach to identifying and addressing issues, with a focus on ownership and accountability. Bonus points if you have: Experience working on a SaaS/PaaS product across multiple cloud providers. Experience with our particular tech stack components and technologies (deep breath): CircleCI, Chronosphere (Prometheus), Splunk, Bazel, Istio, Playwright, Karpenter, Github [Actions] … Experience of the innards and quirks of AWS, GCP and (particularly) Azure. Participated in an on-call rotation - this role involves periodic on-call for the services we own. Experience with Apache Airflow. At Astronomer, we value diversity. We are an equal opportunity employer: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. title: Accounting Success Manager - UK
description: What We Do Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight. Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG. We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI. Who We Are Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility. The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for. Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan. Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software. Who We Need We’re looking for an accountant who wants to be a builder—whether you’ve already moved into a client-facing/solutions role or you’re a current accountant ready to apply your craft with modern tools. Having previous professional accounting or audit experience will allow the candidate to build immediate trust with our customers. You’ll own the long-term relationship with our customers after sales and implementation, partnering with CFOs, Controllers, and Accounting Managers to deliver scalable, automated solutions on Rillet’s AI platform. If you enjoy solving complex accounting problems, client interaction, system configuration, and measurable impact—but don’t have a traditional “Customer Success” background—this role is for you. What You'll Do Own customer relationships and outcomes: Build deep relationships across your customer portfolio, run success plans, and hold recurring meetings to maximize value attainment of Rillet. Deliver unique AI-driven accounting solutions: Translate complex accounting challenges into automated workflows powered by Rillet’s AI platform. Apply accounting expertise: Bridge the gap between technical product capabilities and customer accounting needs, ensuring solutions meet real-world requirements. Drive platform adoption and expansion: Lead trainings to ensure customers are continuously enabled on the platform, advise on process optimization and month-end close efficiency. Cross-functional collaboration: Provide front-line customer feedback to founders and Product in close to real-time, triage support issues with Engineering, and ensure smooth account handoff with Implementation. Become a Product Expert: Develop deep product expertise in Rillet’s AI-native platform, staying up-to-date on the latest features and functionality. Represent Rillet: You’ll be the face of the company and will apply high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every customer interaction is delightful. Who We're Looking For 3+ years of hands-on accounting experience (public audit/assurance or industry GL/Close, Revenue, AP, or Consolidations). Understanding of UK GAAP and the end-to-end close process — even better if you have exposure to IFRS and technical accounting concepts like IFRS 15 / revenue recognition. Proven ability to translate accounting requirements into system configurations and automated workflows. Experience with ERPs (e.g., NetSuite, Intacct) and comfort picking up new finance tools. Bias to action, ownership mindset, and high attention to detail in a fast-moving environment. CPA (active or inactive); prior client-facing/consulting or implementation experience (not required). Life at Rillet Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales. Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create. Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals. Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings. About Encord

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

 

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

Quant Developer in AI

You're a quant developer. You've built high-performance systems that process billions of events per day in real-time, and you care deeply about consistency, correctness and performance. Now you want to build in AI

This is your chance. Encord is a scale-up serving the frontier of physical AI and robotics, the largest technological revolution in history, where what you build ships fast and you own it. Help us build the AI data platform for the future of robotics.

The role

You know how to build systems that are fast and correct under pressure. The hardest problems in AI right now are data problems: distributed, data-intensive systems that have to stay correct and performant at scale.

You will join the Foundations team, who build the data systems that enable frontier robotics labs to generate, understand, train, and test on massive volumes of robotics data. We don’t just react to an order book tick - you will need to handle large 3D scenes, hour-long videos, LIDAR point clouds, and ML inference, all under tight performance and operational budgets.

Why now? A year ago we were a team of 100; now we're over 180 and still accelerating. You'll work directly with a high-bar team, take on high-stakes problems, and help shape where the platform goes next.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, deploy and own data systems processing petabytes of data across billions of items, from design and architectural decisions all the way to deployment, monitoring and measuring impact

  • Build robust distributed systems and reason carefully about how they fail and how they behave under load

  • Design performant protocols and APIs, and tackle complex domains and immense scale with correct and pragmatic solutions, moving extremely fast while maintaining engineering quality.

  • Build as part of a high-performing team, contribute your knowledge and experience to others.

Who you are

  • You have personally developed and maintained systems from scratch, and know what trade-offs are involved in building reliable, performant software at speed. You will have excelled at something demanding, and can show that your good technical decisions day after day compounded into a competitive edge.

  • You may not have AI or ML experience, and that's fine: you are an incredibly fast and curious learner. You can pick up a new topic and quickly become an expert by being ego-less in asking the right questions, and rigorous in performing experiments that propel you up the learning curve.

  • You excel under pressure and uncertainty. You don’t let up the pace, you attack the heart of the problem, and you repeatedly make the right tradeoffs.

  • You deeply care about the systems you build. You take pride in having thought through the failure modes, shipping readable, bulletproof code, and delivering today instead of next week.

  • You enjoy being a member of a high-performing team. You contribute your best work and help others contribute their best. You'll always lend a helping hand when needed and level up those around you.

Experience requirements

  • 1-5+ years building and operating serious institutional-scale systems.

  • Fluency in Python or Typescript and a deep understanding of a least one of Rust, C++, Java or Golang.

  • Solid core CS knowledge in data structures and algorithms, distributed systems concepts (databases, replication, partitioning, queuing, caching) and how they behave under load

  • Experience owning services in production and improving quality through code reviews, testing, rollout and monitoring

  • Experience at a trading firm, market maker, hedge fund or exchange is a plus: trading systems, market data pipelines, tick or time-series stores, risk engines, ML/QR research pipelines, are all relevant to what we build. Experience with large data migrations or re-architecture projects is a plus.

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary, and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

  • Company lunches twice a week

  • Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

What you'll do

  • Own identity and access across Encord, including SSO, MFA, conditional access, and automated joiner/mover/leaver processes.

  • Manage our device security, keeping our macOS fleet protected through MDM and EDR.

  • Run SaaS and AI security: discovering shadow IT, reviewing app permissions, assessing new tools before adoption, and setting sensible guardrails for how AI tools are used.

  • Protect our executives and high-risk users from targeted phishing, impersonation, business email compromise, and AI-enabled fraud such as deepfakes.

  • Act as the technical owner of our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 controls, from policies and evidence through to auditor walkthroughs.

  • Lead third-party and vendor risk assessments.

  • Respond to and lead security incidents, and continuously improve how we detect and handle them.

  • Partner with DevOps and Platform to secure our cloud environment.

  • Write clear policies and runbooks, and roll out changes in a way that keeps the employee experience smooth.

What you'll bring

  • Around 7–8 years of hands-on security experience, with a strong focus on organisation security.

  • Experience rolling out or re-architecting SSO, MFA, and conditional access across a company.

  • Experience deploying and managing MDM and EDR across a macOS fleet.

  • A track record of building automated joiner/mover/leaver flows and user access reviews.

  • Experience running SaaS security, including discovering shadow IT, reviewing app permissions, and assessing new tools before adoption.

  • Experience putting guardrails around AI tool usage, such as approved tool lists, data handling rules, and vendor reviews of AI providers.

  • Ownership of, or significant contribution to, ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2 audits, including policies, control evidence, and auditor walkthroughs.

  • Experience defending against targeted phishing ("whaling") and business email compromise, such as fake CEO payment requests, invoice fraud, and gift card scams.

  • Experience leading or supporting security incidents such as phishing compromises, account takeovers, or lost devices.

  • Experience running third-party and vendor risk assessments and advising on the security of new tools before they're adopted.

  • Experience partnering with DevOps/Platform teams to secure cloud environments (ideally GCP), including IAM, network segmentation, secrets management, logging, and CSPM.

  • A habit of writing policies and runbooks that people can easily follow.

  • A thoughtful approach to change: you've rolled out new controls with clear communication, phased approaches, and a focus on keeping the employee experience smooth.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g. Terraform).

  • Experience owning vulnerability management across infrastructure, including scanning, prioritisation, remediation tracking, and SLAs.

  • Experience building and improving detection and monitoring, centralising logs into a SIEM and defining meaningful alerts.

  • Experience implementing and tuning SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets scanning in CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience coordinating external penetration tests and bug reports, and driving fixes to closure with engineering teams.

  • Experience helping engineers write secure code through guidance, patterns, and lightweight training.

  • Experience supporting sales and customer trust by answering security questionnaires and joining customer security calls.

  • Familiarity with executive digital protection, such as OSINT footprint reviews, impersonation monitoring, and out-of-band verification for sensitive requests.


Why Encord

  • Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

Depending on the assignment, you may be externally facing –&nbsp;managing delivery with our key customers, including major hyper-scalers and frontier model builders –&nbsp;or internally facing, driving the strategic infrastructure and platform programs that power Firmus AI Cloud. In both cases, you will act as the bridge between engineering, operations, and business teams to ensure initiatives land with minimal disruption and maximum value.</p> <p class="FIRBody">As the owner of program delivery, you will translate ambiguity into structured, phased plans, manage complex technical dependencies across stakeholders, and keep everyone aligned from working teams through to executive leadership. You will drive implementation, ensure milestones and adoption targets are met, establish feedback loops, and make the technical trade-off decisions that balance delivery velocity with customer and business impact—whether the “customer” sits outside the company or within it.</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:6,&quot;335551620&quot;:6,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">Key Responsibilities</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p class="FIRBodyList">You’ll own the delivery of your programs end to end –&nbsp;turning ambiguous goals into structured, phased plans with clear scope, timelines, and milestones, and running the operating rhythm of daily or weekly syncs, executive status meetings, and stakeholder communications that keep everyone aligned on readiness, roadmaps, and impact. Throughout, you’ll make the technical trade-off decisions that balance internal velocity against customer and business impact.</p> <p class="FIRBodyList">Depending on the assignment, that delivery is either externally facing—acting as the trusted point of contact for major hyper-scalers and frontier model builders, owning customer communications and advisories, and driving adoption milestones and feedback loops—or internally facing, leading the cross-team platform and infrastructure programs that power Firmus AI Cloud and aligning internal sponsors and engineering leaders on roadmaps and delivery. Either way, you’ll apply the same rigour and stakeholder discipline.</p> <p class="FIRBodyList">Across both, you’ll bring enough command of our systems—AI Factory architecture, GPU performance and benchmarking, and infrastructure constraints—to answer questions directly and validate impact assessments rather than just relaying between teams. You’ll orchestrate delivery across engineering, operations, and customer-facing functions, and run a regular leadership cadence to manage escalations and hold communication timelines.</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">Skills &amp; Experience</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:6,&quot;335551620&quot;:6,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p class="FIRBody">You’ll bring at least 10 years in Technical Program or Project Management, including 4+ years leading large-scale transformation programs, whether that’s with direct external customer exposure or delivering internal enterprise programs. structures often need to be created rather than simply followed.</p> <p class="FIRBody">Ideally, you bring a proven track record delivering programs such as enterprise feature rollouts with title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Optimove, we believe people are capable of more than a single job description. You’re not hired just to fill a position- you’re empowered to shape it, grow it, and make it your own.<br>We call this being Positionless.<br>And Positionless isn’t just our culture. It’s our product.<br>Optimove is the creator of Positionless Marketing, an AI-powered platform that gives every marketer the power to analyze, create, launch, and optimize independently. The result is faster execution, deeper personalization, and 88% greater campaign efficiency.<br>Recognized as a Visionary in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant, we partner with leading brands like Sephora, Staples, and Entain. Today, more than 500 Optimovers across NYC, London, Tel Aviv, Scotland, Brazil, Estonia, and beyond are building the future of marketing together, in an environment that actively encourages ownership and growth, with two out of every three managers promoted from within.<br>If you’re looking for a place where you can do more, be more, come grow with us.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As a Machine Learning Engineer, you'll join our Personalize team, helping shape and build the products that let our customers personalise messages across every digital touchpoint. You'll work with text data and with cutting-edge technologies including Large Language Models (LLMs), bringing Accessible Intelligence to our customers across both Personalize and Optimove's overall platforms.</p> <p>This is a role for an engineer who's ready to own meaningful, medium-sized pieces of our personalisation roadmap end-to-end - from problem framing through to deployment and monitoring - and trusted to do so with minimal oversight. It's not solo delivery: you'll be working closely with a dynamic team spanning ML, MLOps and software engineering, and should be happy to contribute at every level, from early-stage research through to production support.</p> <p><strong>Role &amp; Core Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the delivery of medium-sized ML features end-to-end within Personalize - problem framing, data preparation, model build/train, evaluation, deployment and monitoring - to predictable timelines.</li> <li>Develop predictive ML models for classification, ranking and personalisation, working with our text data.</li> <li>Leverage LLMs and other state-of-the-art techniques to enhance product capabilities.</li> <li>Operationalise models as APIs across real-time and batch environments.</li> <li>Monitor production models in your own scope, treating data quality issues and model degradation as a priority.</li> <li>Research new ML applications and improve pre-existing models, sharing findings with the wider ML, MLOps and engineering team.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with product, MLOps and engineering teams to define and prepare new ML applications, contributing meaningfully to planning and grooming.</li> <li>Proactively surface and resolve technical and data challenges before they affect delivery, model quality or customers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Best Bits of the Job</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exposure to a wide range of ML domains, including large-scale search, ranking, Natural Language Processing, hybridisation, classification and text data processing.</li> <li>Working with modern ML technologies, including LLMs, to enhance our products.</li> <li>Fully real-time architecture for data processing, model development and deployment.</li> <li>Deploying and enhancing ML frameworks, optimising for inference and training/retraining cycles.</li> <li>Online testing of models with live data, using our proprietary A/B/N testing technology to see quickly what performs well.</li> <li>A supportive, collaborative team spanning ML, MLOps and software engineering, where rapid experimentation is the norm.</li> <li>Dedicated time to research new methods, build proofs-of-concept, and ship to production quickly when they work.</li> <li>Everyday use of modern AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude) to speed up experimentation and review.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics or a related field, <strong>OR</strong> 1–4 years' professional experience building and deploying ML models.</li> <li>Strong understanding of core ML concepts - supervised/unsupervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering - and broad familiarity with common algorithms and architectures.</li> <li>Strong Python (pandas, NumPy, etc.) and SQL skills</li> <li>Comfortable with the standard ML toolkit: Git, Docker, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow, and ML pipelines.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with text data and relevant Natural Language Processing techniques.</li> <li>Solid experience with cloud technologies and data storage solutions, including Snowflake.</li> <li>Everyday use of AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude), and a basic understanding of responsible AI practices - data privacy, bias/fairness and explainability.</li> <li>Must be eligible to work in the UK – we are unable to provide sponsorship at this time</li> <li>This is a Hybrid role, and you will be required in our Dundee office two days per week.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understanding of personalisation across domains such as sports betting and gaming, and what best practice looks like there.</li> <li>Full understanding of recommendation algorithms and their applications.</li> <li>Professional experience in personalisation and/or predictive CRM, and micro-segmentation.</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (Terraform, Bicep, etc.).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Growth &amp; Progression</strong></p> <p>This role sits on the in-role path towards Senior Machine Learning Engineer. As you grow, you'll deepen your expertise in our core ML stack, take on end-to-end ownership of larger features, represent the team in cross-functional planning with MLOps and software engineering.</p> <p><strong>Working at Optimove</strong></p> <p>Optimove offers a vibrant, people‑first culture where innovation, ownership, and continuous learning shape everything we do. Our UK team enjoys a modern office with a hybrid work model, daily lunch budget when onsite, and a fully stocked kitchen, along with a wide range of social events throughout the year. We’re committed to helping our people grow in an inclusive, supportive workplace recognised as one of the UK’s Best Workplaces in Tech and for Wellbeing.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Optimove is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants fairly, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.<br><br><br>By submitting this application, you agree that Optimove will process your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including GDPR. For details, see our <a href="https://www.optimove.com/legal/privacy-policy" target="_blank">Privacy Policy</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Solutions Engineer
description: <p><strong>About Nscale</strong></p> <p>Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud supports strategic business outcomes including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.</p> <p>We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Principal Presales Engineer / Solutions Architect to join Nscale’s commercial organisation and play a key role in helping customers understand, evaluate, and adopt our AI infrastructure solutions.</p> <p>This is a deeply technical, customer-facing role at the intersection of sales, solution design, and AI infrastructure. You will partner closely with account executives, product, engineering, and operations teams to support the full sales cycle, from discovery and technical qualification through solution design, product demonstrations, proof of concept support, and customer onboarding.</p> <p>You will need to quickly become fluent in Nscale’s infrastructure, platform capabilities, and software orchestration stack so that you can confidently present our solutions, map customer requirements to technical architectures, and act as a trusted advisor throughout the buying journey.</p> <p>This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical credibility with commercial instinct, enjoys engaging directly with customers, and can translate complex GPU, AI, and cloud concepts into clear business value.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the commercial team in qualifying customer opportunities and identifying technical requirements early in the sales process</li> <li>Deliver compelling product demos, technical presentations, workshops, and architecture sessions for prospective customers and partners</li> <li>Translate customer AI, HPC, and infrastructure requirements into clear solution designs using Nscale’s platform</li> <li>Develop and present solution proposals that align technical architecture with customer business outcomes</li> <li>Work closely with customers to understand workloads, deployment requirements, performance expectations, and scaling plans</li> <li>Build a strong working knowledge of Nscale’s infrastructure stack, GPU cloud platform, APIs, orchestration tooling, and deployment models</li> <li>Support proof of concepts, evaluations, onboarding projects, and technical validation activities</li> <li>Partner with product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure proposed solutions are realistic, scalable, and aligned with platform standards</li> <li>Provide guidance on compute, networking, storage, orchestration, description: <h2>About Nscale</h2> <p>Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.</p> <p>At Nscale, our Infrastructure Operations team plays a critical role in maintaining service availability, driving operational excellence, and ensuring our global data centre estate operates safely, reliably, and efficiently.</p> <p>We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.</p> <hr> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are hiring a Centre of Excellence Senior Engineer to help define, standardise, and continuously improve the way Nscale operates its global data centre estate.</p> <p>This is a senior technical role for someone with deep infrastructure operations experience who enjoys solving complex problems, leading operational improvements, and driving consistency across multiple data centre locations.</p> <p>You'll work closely with Infrastructure Operations, Engineering, Deployment, and Platform teams to establish best practices, improve operational efficiency, lead major infrastructure initiatives, and help shape the future operating model for one of the fastest-growing AI infrastructure companies in the world.</p> <p>This role requires occasional travel to Nscale data centres across multiple countries to support deployments, operational improvements, and critical infrastructure initiatives.</p> <hr> <h2>What you'll be doing</h2> <h3>Infrastructure Operations &amp; Continuous Improvement</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Lead complex infrastructure projects, including hardware installations, upgrades, and operational improvement initiatives.</p> </li> <li> <p>Drive standardisation across Nscale's global data centre estate by developing repeatable operational processes and best practices.</p> </li> <li> <p>Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and service reliability.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support the development of Nscale's Centre of Excellence as the operational authority for infrastructure operations.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Incident Management &amp; Technical Leadership</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Take ownership of complex infrastructure incidents from diagnosis through to resolution.</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead major incident response activities and coordinate technical teams during critical events.</p> </li> <li> <p>Conduct root cause analysis and implement long-term corrective actions to improve platform resilience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Provide technical leadership and mentorship to operations teams across multiple locations.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Capacity Planning &amp; Attributes</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail.</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.</p> </li> <li> <p>Self-starter with a proactive, ownership-driven mindset.</p> </li> <li> <p>Passion for operational excellence and continuous improvement.</p> </li> <li> <p>Able to influence without direct authority and build trusted relationships across teams.</p> </li> </ul> <hr> <h2>What we can offer you</h2> <p>At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. title: Senior Product Manager
description: <p>Senior Product Manager</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> UK (remote)</p> <h1><strong>Job Description</strong></h1> <h2><strong>About Us</strong></h2> <p>Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global SaaS gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees, while driving measurable ROI.</p> <p>We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether it’s engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event &amp; brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.</p> <p>Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stacks and is powered by our world-class team across New York, London, and Lisbon.</p> <p>We’re growing, and we’re currently looking for a Senior Product Manager to join us.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Product Manager at Reachdesk, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the Reachdesk Platform. You will be accountable for turning complex customer and business problems into software products that deliver measurable impact.</p> <p>Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll lead product initiatives end-to-end,&nbsp; from identifying and deeply understanding the right problems to solve, through discovery and delivery, to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.</p> <p>You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, proactively building context across customers, the market, internal stakeholders, data, and technology to understand what Reachdesk needs to achieve its goals. You’ll also make sound decisions when the path forward isn’t obvious.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Engineering and Design and work across the wider business to create alignment, communicate decisions clearly, and ensure what we build is successfully launched, adopted, and delivers the outcomes we set out to achieve.</p> <p>If you enjoy solving difficult problems, taking ownership, and moving comfortably between customer, technical, and business conversations, you’ll thrive in this role.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Set product direction and priorities</strong>, bringing together company goals, internal stakeholder needs, customer insight, market context, data, and technical considerations to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Define problems and experiences before solutions</strong>, creating clear stories, journeys, and shared context so the Design and Engineering teams understand the problem and intended outcomes before determining the solution.</li> <li><strong>Lead product initiatives end-to-end</strong>, from discovery and solution definition through delivery, rollout, and iteration, partnering with Engineering to manage scope, make pragmatic trade-offs, and deliver valuable solutions at pace.</li> <li><strong>Make sound product decisions and trade-offs</strong>, balancing customer and business needs, commercial impact, user experience, and technical considerations while aligning the wider business on compromises, priorities, and expectations.</li> <li><strong>Develop product opportunities with external partners</strong>, building relationships with technology partners to uncover mutual opportunities, shape integrations, align roadmaps, and navigate the product and commercial considerations required to bring them to market.</li> <li><strong>Orchestrate successful launches and adoption</strong>, working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Logistics, Finance, Legal, and other teams to ensure the business is ready and customers realise value from what we build.</li> <li><strong>Communicate with clarity throughout</strong>, ensuring leadership and teams across Reachdesk understand product decisions, progress, risks, changes, and results.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>About you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have a strong track record of <strong>owning B2B SaaS products end-to-end</strong>, from identifying the right problems through delivery, adoption, and measurable customer and business outcomes.</li> <li>You’re a <strong>strong problem solver</strong> who gets to the root of complex problems, brings structure to ambiguity, and uses evidence and judgement to determine the right path forward.</li> <li>You operate with <strong>independence and initiative</strong>: you seek out the customers, stakeholders, data, and context you need rather than waiting for direction, while staying anchored to Reachdesk’s goals and priorities.</li> <li>You have <strong>strong business and commercial awareness</strong> and are curious about how the wider company operates, allowing you to understand competing needs and make pragmatic decisions beyond the boundaries of Product.</li> <li>You’re <strong>technically fluent enough to work effectively with Engineering</strong>, understand systems, integrations, and constraints, ask the right questions, and contribute meaningfully to solution and scope decisions.</li> <li>You’re an <strong>exceptional communicator</strong>, able to create clarity, influence decisions, surface difficult trade-offs, and adapt how you communicate across customers, engineers, leadership, and teams throughout the business.</li> <li>You’re comfortable <strong>operating externally as well as internally</strong>, building productive relationships with technology partners, uncovering shared opportunities, influencing without authority, and navigating product, technical, and commercial conversations.</li> <li>You have a strong sense of <strong>product and user experience</strong>, caring about the coherence and quality of the complete experience rather than whether individual requirements or features have simply been delivered.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>The benefits</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary with generous stock options</li> <li>Pension with employer contributions (NEST)</li> <li>Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care</li> <li>Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments</li> <li>A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.&nbsp;</p> <p><br>Privacy Policy: We process personal information submitted as part of your application in accordance with the Reachdesk Candidate Privacy Notice. Please review Reachdesk’s Privacy Policy here: <a href="http://www.reachdesk.com/candidate-privacy-policy">www.reachdesk.com/candidate-privacy-policy</a></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
